summary: A cardholder makes ordinary purchases during a billing cycle, stays under the credit limit, receives a statement, and then pays the full statement balance before the due date. The scenario is designed to show an on-time full-payment path with the purchase grace period preserved and no late or over-limit fee triggered.
assumptions: The account has no previous balance at the start of this billing cycle, so the purchase grace-period condition is satisfied under clause.6.grace_period.
The credit limit is $1000.00, and the total purchases in the cycle never exceed that limit, satisfying clause.4.credit_limits.
The periodic statement closes on 2025-05-31 and sets a payment due date of 2025-06-25, which provides at least 25 days after statement close.
All payments are made by an approved standard payment method and are credited on the date received.
Because the cardholder pays the full new balance by the due date, no late fee is triggered and no purchase interest is imposed for this cycle.
No cash advances, returned payments, disputed charges, illegal transactions, or other default-triggering events occur in this scenario.
